lines: Teri nigah se aisi sharab pi maine
Phir na hosh ka dawa kiya kabhi maine
couplets.en: I drank such wine from your gaze that I never again claimed to be sober.

lines: Woh aur honge jinhen maut aa gayi hogi
Nigah-e-yaar se paayi hai zindagi maine
couplets.en: Death may have come for others, but I found life in my beloved's gaze.

lines: Ai gham-e-zindagi
couplets.en: O sorrow of my life.

lines: Ai gham-e-zindagi, kuchh to de mashwara
couplets.en: O sorrow of my life, give me some counsel.

lines: Ai gham-e-zindagi, kuchh to de mashwara
Ek taraf uska ghar, ek taraf maikada
couplets.en: O sorrow of my life, advise me, with her house on one side and the tavern on the other.

lines: Ek taraf uska ghar, ek taraf maikada
Main kahan jaaun, hota nahin faisla
couplets.en: Her house lies one way and the tavern the other, and I cannot decide where to go.

lines: Main kahan jaaun, hota nahin faisla
Ek taraf uska ghar, ek taraf maikada
couplets.en: How am I to choose between her house and the tavern?

lines: Ek taraf uska ghar, ek taraf maikada
couplets.en: Her house lies one way and the tavern the other.

lines: Ek taraf baam par koi gulfam hai
Ek taraf mehfil-e-baada-o-jaam hai
couplets.en: On one side a rose-faced beauty stands on the roof, and on the other the company gathers over wine.

lines: Ek taraf baam par koi gulfam hai
Ek taraf mehfil-e-baada-o-jaam hai
couplets.en: On one side a rose-faced beauty stands on the roof, and on the other the company gathers over wine.

lines: Dil ka donon se hai kuchh na kuchh wasta
Ek taraf uska ghar, ek taraf maikada
couplets.en: Some tie of the heart binds me to both her house and the tavern.

lines: Uske dar se utha to kidhar jaaunga
Maikada chhod dunga to mar jaaunga
couplets.en: Where could I go if I left her doorstep, when leaving the tavern would be the death of me?

lines: Uske dar se utha to kidhar jaaunga

lines: Chhod dunga to mar jaaunga
Sakht mushkil mein hoon, kya karun ai Khuda?
couplets.en: Leaving would be the death of me, so tell me, God, what am I to do?

lines: Ek taraf uska ghar, ek taraf maikada
Ek taraf uska ghar, ek taraf maikada
couplets.en: Her house lies one way and the tavern the other.

lines: Zindagi ek hai aur talabgaar do
Aur talabgaar do
couplets.en: I have one life, and two lay claim to it.

lines: Zindagi ek hai aur talabgaar do
Jaan akeli magar jaan ke haqdar do
couplets.en: I have only one life to give, yet two have a right to it.

lines: Zindagi ek hai aur talabgaar do

lines: Dil bata pehle kis ka karun haq ada
Ek taraf uska ghar, ek taraf maikada
couplets.en: Tell me, heart, which claim should I honour first, hers or the tavern's?

lines: Is talluq ko main kaise todun Zafar
Kis ko apnaun main, kis ko chhodun Zafar
couplets.en: How can I break this bond, Zafar, and which should I take to heart, which leave behind?
